title: Deep learning identifies morphological determinants of sex differences in the pre-adolescent brain.
summary: Deep learning on ABCD structural MRI identifies a cerebellar and subcortical sex-difference pattern tied to puberty, a distinct field result with an identified enabling AI role and cohort-scale evaluation. The conclusion is limited to the reported study setting.
